raw_verdict.overall: This logbook provides only narrow CPU-based toy mechanism checks: a 4×4 Sinkhorn projection invariant test, a synthetic dimensional shape ablation, and a random-matrix propagation audit. No trained-model experiments, systems benchmarks, or downstream evaluations were performed, leaving the paper's core empirical claims unaddressed.
